text.p: Republic Industries Inc said it was the successful bidder and will buy two car dealerships in Los Angeles for $15.86 million plus the value of certain assets.
Together, the Magic Ford and Magic Lincoln-Mercury dealerships generate about $250 million in annual revenue, Republic said.
It said the purchase was approved Tuesday by U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California. The dealerships have been under bankruptcy protection, Republic said.
The closing of the transaction is expected to occur by the end of this month.
Republic is a diversified company operating in the automotive, solid waste, electronic security and out-of-home media industries.
